origin: recorded 2026-11-16 by tests/real_cli/record.py: background sessions of the pinned CLI (claude --bg) against a local stand-in of the Messages API on loopback, with a configuration folder of its own, a key helper that prints a dummy key and a trust entry for the working folder; no login and no model call

files.launch.json: what the launch command printed per case, with its exit code
files.sessions.json: one entry of claude agents --json --all per state
files.commands.json: what stop, rm and daemon status printed, with their exit codes
files.transcript_<scenario>.jsonl: the session transcript of a scenario, reduced to the record types the runner reads (of the attachments only queued_command); every other type is dropped, among them session-owner and the attachments session_context and credential_org, which hold account identifiers
files.transcript_login.jsonl: one turn of a session that got a dummy token in the place of the key helper, so its request record lists the beta of a request on a stored login; the token is no credential, and a proxy on loopback that refuses every request was the only way out of the CLI but the stand-in
files.stream_<scenario>.jsonl: the stream-json output of the same scenario as a print turn (claude -p); the init message reduced to the fields the runner reads
files.transcript_fields.json: the members the CLI wrote per transcript record type and in an entry of the session list (names only)

note: Paths replaced by /work and /record. after_turn lists, per scenario, the status the session list showed after each turn end. Every answer comes from the stand-in, so no recording holds a text of a person.
